usage.source_scope: 开放词汇的语言到部件 affordance grounding。
usage.project_application: 用于生成候选功能部件名称/提示，随后必须由视觉与几何证据验证。
usage.modifications: LLM 只产生 proposal；不读取 private truth，不直接决定完成，也不能覆盖 absent/UNKNOWN。
usage.expected_effect: 提高长尾功能部件的候选覆盖，同时保留可验证的视觉落点。

evaluation.setup: 未执行；最小证伪实验：冻结视觉候选与 evaluator，只比较固定类别词表和开放词汇部件提示；主指标为 true-part proposal recall、wrong-part precision 和 absent false proposal。
evaluation.claim_boundary: 语义上合理的 LLM 输出不是物理 affordance 真值；未在 BlindAssist 复现，不能推出开放世界可靠性、真实操控、用户收益或安全。

evidence.summary: Primary source reviewed for mechanism and evidence boundary; no BlindAssist reproduction is implied.

history.change: Added from the user-provided directed literature review as a candidate only; no route authority or experimental result was created.
